title: ref_exists resolves a ref spelled CairnCommons/<rel>
intention: grammar._ref_exists resolves a ref whose first part is CairnCommons under the commons beside the root, so a survey holding at a commons file resolves.
why: Measured 2026-11-16: 3f2692580b2f's walk (q173c) was refused at survey_holdings_resolve, 'holding 0 names an address that does not resolve', for CairnCommons/.gitattributes, which exists. _ref_exists joins the ref onto the commons itself and looks for CairnCommons/CairnCommons/.gitattributes. ref_exists('CairnCommons/.gitattributes') is False and ref_exists('.gitattributes') is True on akiendelllinux.
traces_to: Law 3 (the survey judge reports a real file as absent) and Law 1 (look() already fixed the same doubling under ticket 7a31059daa23).
how: One extra try in _ref_exists: when the ref's first part is CairnCommons, join it onto dirname(root). A red-first proof over a scratch cairn+CairnCommons pair.

clauses.claim: CairnCommons/.gitattributes resolves when the commons beside the root carries it
bare commons rels and cairn rels still resolve, and CairnCommons/<a missing file> and CairnCommons/<a file only the cairn root holds> do not

decisions.text: D1: in _ref_exists, after the <commons>/<ref> try and before the ticket-by-id fallback, a ref whose first part is 'CairnCommons' (either slash) is tried at os.path.join(dirname(root), ref); a comment cites this ticket and 7a31059daa23.
D2: the proof calls the pure _ref_exists(ref, root, set()) over a scratch root pair, one tooth per clause, PROVES keys 1..3; test_chain_grammar.py re-runs as the sibling.
